apps.name: SwiftIPA
apps.subtitle: Sign IPAs, fast
apps.localizedDescription: SwiftIPA is a local, on-device IPA signer for iOS built around zsign compiled straight into the app. Bundle ID, name, version, entitlements, tweaks, modifiers — sign it all in seconds, resign the same app instantly from its own cache, or sign a whole batch of apps in parallel across every core on your device. No account, no server, no analytics.

versions.localizedDescription:
- Fix the itms-services manifest URL losing its fetchurl parameter to under-escaping, and add a localhost fallback for the no-profile install path
- Update AltStore source for build 19

- Scrub competitor name from the newest changelog text in the AltStore source
- Update AltStore source for build 18
- Fix the no-profile install path: serve the manifest through a properly reachable HTTPS source
- Update AltStore source for build 17
- Refine install trigger logic: HTTPS+LAN with a direct itms-services open is the default (the proven primary path), plain HTTP+LAN through the embedded Safari redirect page is now the true no-trust fallback

- Fix the no-profile install path: serve the manifest through a properly reachable HTTPS source
- Update AltStore source for build 17

- Refine install trigger logic: HTTPS+LAN with a direct itms-services open is the default, plain HTTP+LAN through the embedded Safari redirect page is now the true no-trust fallback
- Update AltStore source for build 16

- Scrub competitor name from the changelog text baked into the AltStore source
- Fix IPA import: remove the custom ipa UTI declaration that may have conflicted with system type resolution, and defer the actual file read until after the document picker has fully dismissed; make Export IPA the clear primary install path since direct on-device install depends on iOS version and network
- Update AltStore source for build 15
- Switch IPA import from SwiftUI's native fileImporter to the same UIDocumentPickerViewController wrapper already used for certificates and tweaks, since fileImporter's Open button wasn't confirming a selection regardless of source folder while the other import paths worked fine
- Update AltStore source for build 14
- Trigger install via an embedded Safari view loading a local HTML redirect page instead of opening itms-services:// directly from app code
- Update AltStore source for build 13
- Rework local install: default to plain HTTP over loopback (127.0.0.1) and dropping the certificate trust step entirely for the default path; HTTPS+Wi-Fi+trust stays as a one-tap fallback if the fast path doesn't work

- Switch IPA import from SwiftUI's native fileImporter to the same UIDocumentPickerViewController wrapper already used for certificates and tweaks, since fileImporter's Open button wasn't confirming a selection regardless of source folder while the other import paths worked fine
- Update AltStore source for build 14

- Fix onDelete no longer available after chaining listRowSeparator before it: reorder onDelete right after ForEach in Library/Certificates/Sources
- Fix Swift type-checker timeouts in Library/Sources/Certificates/Tweaks lists by extracting row and list content into separate typed views; improve the install trust flow with clear one-time setup steps
- Restructure: move Certificates into Settings, add global default signing options, categorize the signing screen into clearer sections with icons, card-style rows across Library/Sources/Certificates/Tweaks; bump app version; retry+authenticate CI dependency fetch
- Widen file pickers to also accept public.item (helps some third-party File Provider sources); point users to the Share Sheet as the reliable path for browser downloads, since that bypasses the document picker entirely
- Update AltStore source for build 8

- Fix file pickers not confirming selection: UTType(filenameExtension:) synthesized a dynamic UTI that didn't match the real file's type, silently blocking Open. Use broad, always-matching types instead across all pickers.
- Update AltStore source for build 7

- Add the missing openssl/x509v3.h include for the self-signed identity generator
- Fix certificate validity date reading: SecCertificateCopyValues and the X.509 OID constants aren't available on iOS, use OpenSSL directly instead
- Fix provisioning profile parsing: use zsign's CMS decoder instead of the macOS-only CMSDecoder API
- Initial commit: SwiftIPA, an on-device IPA signer built on zsign
